# Curavex

> Clinical treatment response regression and precision pharmacology MLOps platform.
> Architected and developed by Krish Ujeniya (@krishujeniya).
> Developer Profile: https://github.com/krishujeniya
> Portfolio Showcase: https://krishujeniya.github.io/MostlyOutlier/
> Live Site: https://krishujeniya.github.io/curavex/
> Source Repository: https://github.com/krishujeniya/curavex

## Overview
Curavex bridges clinical pharmacology datasets with predictive machine learning models to estimate drug efficacy, identify multi-gene response biomarkers, and maintain GxP-compliant audit records.

## Author & Ecosystem
- Author: Krish Ujeniya (https://github.com/krishujeniya)
- Canonical Person Entity: https://krishujeniya.github.io/#krishujeniya
- Linked Projects: AGYOS, Hadron, WaferPulse, Somnostasis, Hajree, Scanlark, TraceMigo

## Key Clinical & MLOps Capabilities
- Dose-Response Modeling: Semi-parametric Hill equation curve fitting and IC50 / AUC regression benchmarks.
- Clinical Trial Ingestion: Harmonized ingestion of pharmacology profiles with automated schema validation.
- Model Auditing: Continuous drift detection against clinical demographic shifts and covariate anomalies.
